hero.title: Write it all off your chest.
hero.subtitle: A place for thoughts, journal and stories. Private if you want. Read if you share. No counters, no algorithm.
hero.note: Free. No ads. Runs in the browser, installable on phone and desktop.
hero.screenshotAlt: The editor in the browser: an empty page with a short text, no tools in the way.

noPressure.title: No pressure.
noPressure.body: No likes, no followers, no view counts. Just you and your text, and whoever should read it.

noAlgorithm.title: No algorithm.
noAlgorithm.body: Your feed is chronological. Nobody decides for you what you see.

noReaders.title: No one reading along.
noReaders.body: Private entries are encrypted in your browser before they reach us. We cannot read them.

write.title: Write
write.body: The editor opens empty. No title needed, no formatting needed.

decide.title: Decide
decide.body: Keep it, share it anonymously or share it with your pseudonym.

letGo.title: Let go
letGo.body: Optionally let it disappear after 24 hours or 7 days. Or burn it right away.

beRead.title: Be read
beRead.body: You see that it was read and how many feel it. Nobody else sees numbers.

reflection.title: Thought rooms
reflection.body: Chronological, no voting, mostly anonymous. For what has to get out.
reflection.example: Three in the morning. The street below is empty, and I do not know if I am tired or just quiet. I am writing this so it exists somewhere that is not me.

fiction.title: Story rooms
fiction.body: With voting and feedback, with a pseudonym. For what wants to be read.
fiction.example: She had missed the train three times, always on purpose. The fourth time it simply stood there, doors open, waiting as if it had time.

trust.title: Trust

do.title: What we do with your data
items: Private texts are encrypted in the browser; the server stores ciphertext only.
Shared texts live on servers in the EU.
Burned texts are gone from backups after 30 days as well.
You can export everything as a ZIP or delete your account at any time, in the app, without e-mailing support.

dont.title: What we do not do
items: No training of AI models on your texts.
No dark patterns when you leave.

trust.links: More in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the <imprint>imprint</imprint>.

safety.title: Sometimes writing is not enough.
safety.body: When a text sounds like a hard moment, the app discreetly shows where to find help. The hint is produced in your browser from a word list, without the text reaching us.
safety.promise: We do not read your texts. The hint appears only for you, in your browser.
safety.lines: Die Dargebotene Hand 143 · Pro Juventute 147 · Germany: Telefonseelsorge 0800 111 0 111

install.title: On your home screen
install.body: The app installs like a native app. iOS: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Android and desktop: the browser’s install dialog.
install.native: A native iOS app is in the works.

pricing.title: Price
pricing.body: Free at launch. Later an optional membership (about CHF 3/month) for unlimited export, series and more rooms. The core stays free. Never ads.

items.a: Towards other members, yes: anonymous texts carry neither pseudonym nor profile, and the link to the account is removed on the server before the text is delivered. Towards us, no: internally the text stays linked to your account so abuse can be stopped. The privacy policy says exactly that.

items.q: Can you read my private texts?
items.a: No. Private entries are encrypted in your browser with a key that exists only on your device. The server stores ciphertext. The limit: we also deliver the code that does the encrypting. A compromised server could deliver manipulated code. Content Security Policy, published build hashes and later the native app address this.

items.q: What if I lose my recovery code?
items.a: Then private entries can no longer be read on a new device. We have no copy of the key and cannot reset it. Shared texts and your account remain. You can show and save the code again in settings at any time.
The web app installs on phone and desktop and then behaves like an app, offline too. A native iOS app is planned.
Writing, saving and finishing work without a connection. Publishing waits in a queue until you are back online.

Every shared text can be reported. Reports go to a review queue handled by people, within one hour for self-harm, otherwise within a day. After three independent reports a text is hidden until review. Nothing is deleted automatically by software.

items.q: Do you train AI on my texts?
items.a: No. Neither on private nor on shared texts. There is no AI writing help in the editor either: no suggestions, no rephrasing, no mood analysis.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: In settings under “Data”. Deletion has a 30-day grace period during which you can revoke it. After that everything is gone for good, from backups at most 30 further days later.
A small company in Switzerland. Name, address and the responsible person are in the imprint. We answer questions by e-mail, critical ones too.
